mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_records (customer_id, assessment, recommendation, record_date, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{assessment}, #{recommendation}, #{recordDate}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT hr.id, hr.customer_id, hr.assessment, hr.recommendation, hr.record_date, hr.created_by, hr.created_at, u.display_name AS created_by_name FROM health_records hr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = hr.created_by WHERE hr.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY hr.record_date DESC, hr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT hr.id, hr.customer_id, hr.assessment, hr.recommendation, hr.record_date, hr.created_by, hr.created_at, u.display_name AS created_by_name FROM health_records hr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = hr.created_by WHERE hr.id = #{recordId} AND hr.customer_id = #{customerId}
